articles.headline: Hong Kong Windsurfers Claim Historic Double Gold at Asian Games
articles.summary_html:
Hong Kong's windsurfing squad delivered a watershed momenta turning point of great significance轉捩點；分水嶺 for the city's sporting history on Saturday, as teenage sailors Wong Tsz-ho and Cheung Tsz-yuet each claimed gold in the youth iQFoil events at the 20th Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan. Their twin triumphstwo closely linked victories achieved together雙喜臨門；兩項同時勝利 propelled Hong Kong's gold tally into double figures for the first time since the territory began competing in the Games in 1954 — a milestone achieved barely an hour after tennis player Coleman Wong Chak-lam secured a record-equallingmatching a previous best achievement打平紀錄的 eighth gold in the men's singles.

Wong Tsz-ho put in a commanding displaya performance that dominates the competition壓倒性的表現 across eleven grueling rounds of racing, crossing the finish line first on six occasions to seal the boys' title. In the girls' event, 17-year-old Cheung Tsz-yuet proved equally dominant, winning nine of her races to clinchto secure something after a close contest終於奪得；鎖定 a podium finish many had anticipated after her encouraging showing at this year's world championships in Spain. Their victories meant Hong Kong had already surpassed its previous best gold haul of eight, a mark the delegation had reached three times before, in 2010, 2018 and 2023.

With the total medal count edging towards the all-time record of 53 set in Hangzhou three years ago, officials were quick to credit the breakthrough to sustained investment in grassroots pathwayssystems that identify and develop talent from a young age基層培訓途徑, insisting that identifying promising youngsters early and nurturing them through structured training has finally begun to translate into tangible resultsoutcomes that are concrete and measurable實質成果 on the international stage. Observers have nonetheless cautioned that converting isolated triumphs into a lasting sporting legacy will require continued funding long after the closing ceremony, so that the achievements of this golden generation do not prove to be a fleeting high pointa peak of success that quickly passes曇花一現；短暫的高峰.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港滑浪風帆代表隊在星期六為本港體壇歷史寫下重要一章，兩名少年風帆手王子浩及張芷月分別在日本愛知·名古屋第二十屆亞運會的青年iQFoil項目中奪得金牌。這兩面金牌令香港自一九五四年參加亞運會以來，金牌數目首次踏入雙位數——而就在不足一小時前，網球手黃澤林剛剛在男子單打項目中奪得追平歷史紀錄的第八面金牌。

王子浩在十一輪艱苦的賽事中表現強勢，六次率先衝線，鎖定男子組冠軍寶座。女子組方面，十七歲的張芷月同樣技壓全場，贏得九場賽事，摘下不少人在她今年於西班牙世界錦標賽交出亮眼成績後已預料的獎牌席位。二人的勝利意味香港已超越過去八面金牌的最佳紀錄——該紀錄曾在二零一零年、二零一八年及二零二三年三度打平。

隨著獎牌總數漸漸逼近三年前杭州亞運會創下的五十三面歷史紀錄，官員紛紛將這次突破歸功於對基層培訓途徑的持續投放，強調及早發掘有潛質的年輕選手並透過系統化訓練加以培育，終於開始在國際賽場上轉化為實質成果。然而，有觀察者提醒，要將個別的勝利轉化為持久的體育遺產，閉幕禮過後仍須持續投放資源，否則這一代黃金選手的成就恐怕只會是曇花一現。

articles.headline: Hong Kong Raises Minimum Wage for Foreign Domestic Helpers to HK$5,220
articles.summary_html:
The Hong Kong government announced on Friday that the minimum allowable wagethe lowest salary an employer is legally permitted to pay法定最低工資 for foreign domestic helpers will rise by 2.35 per cent, from HK$5,100 to HK$5,220 a month, with the new rate applying to all contracts signed on or after October 3. The food allowance that employers must provide will remain unchanged at no less than HK$1,236 a month. The adjustment, the latest in an annual reviewa yearly process of checking and updating something一年一度的檢討 that has become something of a ritual for the city's roughly 380,000 households employing live-in helpers, arrives as the cost of domestic help continues to climb alongside broader living expenses.

Officials said the revised figure took into account Hong Kong's overall economic performance, prevailing labour market conditions, employers' ability to pay, and the basic livelihood needsthe essential requirements for a person to live decently基本生活需要 of helpers themselves. The government stressed that contracts signed before the cut-off at the old rate would still be processed, provided applications reach the Immigration Department within a grace periodextra time allowed before a rule takes full effect寬限期. Unlike previous years, when adjustments were sometimes frozen amid economic headwinds, this year's rise, though modest, signals a continuation of incremental increasessmall, gradual rises over time逐步的小幅加幅 rather than a pause.

The announcement has nonetheless reignited a familiar tug-of-wara struggle between two sides pulling in opposite directions拉鋸戰 between stakeholders. Helper unions, which had lobbied for a far steeper rise to as much as HK$6,670 citing persistent inflation, dismissed the increase as inadequate, while employer associations warned that even incremental rises strain household budgetsthe amount of money a family has to spend家庭開支預算 already squeezed by a sluggish economy. For the tens of thousands of dual-income familieshouseholds where both partners earn a salary雙職家庭 and elderly households that depend on helpers for childcare and caregiving, the episode is a reminder of how deeply this workforce is woven into the fabric of domestic lifedeeply and inseparably part of everyday home life深深融入家庭生活之中 in the city.
articles.summary_zh_html:
香港政府星期五宣布，外籍家庭傭工的法定最低工資將由每月五千一百元上調百分之二點三五至五千二百二十元，新工資水平適用於十月三日或之後簽訂的所有合約。僱主須提供的膳食津貼則維持不變，每月不少於一千二百三十六元。這次調整是一年一度檢討機制下的最新安排，對本港約三十八萬個聘用住家外傭的家庭而言已幾近成為慣例，而外傭成本亦隨著整體生活開支上升而持續攀升。

官員表示，新工資水平已考慮香港整體經濟表現、現行勞工市場狀況、僱主的負擔能力，以及外傭本身的基本生活需要。政府強調，於截止日期前以舊工資水平簽訂的合約仍會獲處理，惟申請須在寬限期內送達入境處。與過往部分年度因經濟逆風而工資凍結不同，今年的升幅雖然輕微，卻顯示工資持續小幅上調，而非再次停滯不前。

不過，今次公布亦重新燃起各方之間一場熟悉的角力。外傭工會一直以持續通脹為理由，爭取大幅加薪至每月六千六百七十元，故斥今次升幅並不足夠；僱主組織則警告，即使是輕微的加幅，亦會令本已因經濟疲弱而捉襟見肘的家庭開支百上加斤。對於數以萬計依靠外傭照顧子女及長者的雙職家庭和長者住戶而言，這次爭議提醒了大眾，這批勞動力早已深深融入本港家庭生活的日常肌理之中。

articles.source_url: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60395815/蔡天鳳案-開案-租村屋後連日購物-鄺球買碎肉機時亦問碎骨機
articles.headline: Prosecution Opens Case in Abby Choi Murder Trial, Alleging Premeditated Plan
articles.summary_html:
Prosecutors opened their case on Thursday in the long-awaited murder trial over the killing of Hong Kong socialite Abby Choi Tin-fung, alleging that her former husband and his relatives had meticulously plannedprepared something with extreme care and attention to detail精心策劃 the crime well before her remains were discovered. Alex Kwong Kong-chi, his father Kwong Kau and his brother Anthony Kwong Kong-kit stand jointly charged with murder and with preventing the lawful burial of a body, more than three and a half years after Choi's dismembered remainsa body that has been cut into separate pieces被肢解的遺體 were found at a rented village house in Tai Po.

According to the prosecution, the trio rented the ground-floor property in the weeks before Choi's death and embarked on a series of purchases that betrayed their intentrevealed a hidden plan or motive暴露了他們的意圖: among the items acquired was an industrial meat grinder, and the court heard that Kwong Kau had also enquired about a bone grinder while making the purchase. Taken together with other equipment later recovered at the scene, prosecutors argued the shopping spree pointed unmistakably to a premeditated plana plan made and thought through in advance預謀計劃 to dismember and dispose of a body, rather than a crime committed in the heat of the momenta sudden burst of emotion without forethought一時衝動.

The trial, expected to run for 45 days, had already been delayed once after a juror was discharged on health grounds, forcing a replacement to be empanelledformally selected to serve on a jury獲遴選加入陪審團. Legal commentators note that the case has drawn intense public scrutinyclose and critical attention from the public公眾的高度關注 partly because it exposes how a bitter family dispute over property and finances could escalate into calculated brutalitygrow step by step into deliberate, extreme violence演變成有計算的殘暴行為, raising uncomfortable questions about domestic conflict, inheritance disputes and the adequacy of safeguards for individuals caught in deteriorating family relationships long before matters turn violent.
articles.summary_zh_html:
檢方星期四在萬眾期待的香港名媛蔡天鳳遇害案審訊中開案陳詞，指其前夫及其家人早於遺體被發現之前，已經精心策劃這場謀殺案。鄺港智、其父鄺球及其兄鄺港傑三人被控謀殺罪及阻止遺體合法埋葬罪，距離蔡天鳳被肢解的遺體在大埔一間租用的村屋內被發現，已逾三年半。

根據控方陳述，三人在蔡天鳳死前數星期租用該地下村屋，並連日購物，而這些購物行為正正暴露了他們的意圖：當中購買的物品包括一台工業用碎肉機，而法庭亦聽到鄺球在購買碎肉機時，亦曾問及碎骨機。結合現場後來起出的其他器具，控方指這連日的購物行為明確顯示，這是一場有預謀的肢解及棄屍計劃，而非一時衝動所犯下的罪行。

審訊預計將持續四十五天，早前已因一名陪審員以健康理由獲准退任，需要重新遴選替補陪審員而一度延後。法律評論員指出，此案備受公眾高度關注，部分原因在於案件揭示一場因財產及金錢而起的激烈家庭糾紛，竟可演變成有計算的殘暴行為，亦引起社會對家庭衝突、遺產糾紛，以及在關係惡化至演變成暴力之前，社會能否及時為相關人士提供足夠保障等問題的不安思考。

Forensic evidence from the rented flat will form a key part of the trial.

articles.headline: Nursing Job Market Row Deepens as Lo Chung-mau Urges Facts Over Rhetoric
articles.summary_html:
A seemingly routine radio phone-in call to the Chief Executive has snowballed into a public rowgrown quickly from something small into a major dispute演變成一場公眾爭議 over Hong Kong's nursing job market, after a caller identified only as Mr Kwok questioned whether an influx of non-locally trained nurses was crowding out fresh graduatestaking up opportunities that would otherwise go to new graduates擠走新鮮人畢業生 from the profession. The remark prompted Executive Council member Tommy Cheung Yu-yan to suggest the caller had been coached by a unionsecretly guided or instructed by a labour organisation受工會操控 pushing its own agenda, an accusation Kwok firmly rejected, insisting he held no grudge against mainland medical staff and describing himself as a committed supporter of the establishment.

Stepping into the fray, Secretary for Health Lo Chung-mau urged all sides to anchor the debate in verified figuresbase an argument firmly on confirmed, factual data以核實數據作討論基礎 rather than hearsay, warning that unsubstantiated claimsstatements made without solid supporting evidence未經證實的言論 about the job market only deter prospective recruits and ultimately leave Hong Kong to bear the consequences of a worsening shortfall. Officials have repeatedly pointed to rising numbers of full-time nurses and a falling attrition ratethe rate at which staff leave a job or profession流失率 as evidence that recruitment reforms, including pathways for non-locally trained staff, are easing pressure rather than displacing local talent.

The episode lays bare a delicate balancing acta situation requiring careful management of competing needs微妙的平衡任務 facing the city: plugging an acute shortage of healthcare workers through imported talent while reassuring a new generation of local nursing graduates that their career prospects have not been sacrificed in the process. With training places having expanded sharply in recent years, how authorities reconcile these competing pressures is likely to shape not only the morale of the nursing workforce but also public confidence in the government's broader manpower planningthe strategic organisation of a workforce to meet future needs人力規劃.
articles.summary_zh_html:
一個看似平常的電台烽煙節目來電，演變成一場有關本港護士就業市場的公眾爭議。一名僅以「郭先生」身分受訪的來電者質疑，大量非本地培訓護士湧入會否擠走本地應屆畢業生的就業機會。行政會議成員張宇人聞言後暗示，該名來電者是受某工會操控以推動其自身議程，郭先生則堅決否認此說法，強調自己對內地醫護人員並無怨懟，並形容自己是堅定支持建制的愛國人士。

醫務衛生局局長盧寵茂亦加入爭論，呼籲各方應以核實數據而非道聽途說作討論基礎，並警告有關就業市場的不實言論只會嚇怕有意入行的新血，最終令香港要自行承受人手短缺惡化的後果。官員多次強調，全職護士人數上升、流失率回落，正正證明包括容許非本地培訓人員執業等招聘改革，是在緩解人手壓力，而非擠走本地人才。

這場爭議揭示本港正面對一項微妙的平衡任務：既要透過輸入人才填補醫療人手的嚴重短缺，同時亦要讓新一代本地護士畢業生安心，確保他們的事業前景沒有因此犧牲。隨著近年培訓學額大幅增加，當局如何在這些互相競逐的壓力之間取得平衡，不但將影響護理行業的士氣，亦勢將左右公眾對政府整體人力規劃的信心。

trends.headline: 💨 Hongkongers Clash Over Ear-Piercing Portable Fan Noise
trends.summary_html: A seemingly trivial gripe about handheld fans has snowballed into one of Threads' most heated debates this week, after Hong Kong commuters began swapping stories of being trapped beside strangers blasting piercingsharp, high-pitched and uncomfortable to hear刺耳的 fan noise on packed buses and trains. One widely shared post, in which a passenger was filmed confronting a fan-wielding commuter, racked up tens of thousands of views and ignited a sprawling thread of agreement and backlash. Some networks called for legislation cappingsetting an upper limit on something設定上限 fan decibel levels in enclosed public spaces, while others accused critics of policing other people's basic comfort in a city already short on breathing room.
trends.summary_zh_html: 一宗看似微不足道、關於手提風扇的小爭拗，本星期在Threads演變成最熾熱的話題之一，事緣有香港乘客開始分享自己被困在擠迫巴士及列車上，被陌生人開著的刺耳風扇聲音「夾擊」的經歷。其中一則廣傳帖文，拍到一名乘客與開著風扇的乘客當場理論，瀏覽量高達數萬，並掀起一連串支持與反對的龐大討論。有網民要求就密閉公共空間的風扇噪音訂立分貝上限的法例，亦有人反駁批評者是在一個本已擁擠不堪的城市裡，過度干預他人的基本生活舒適。

causes.label: Noise etiquette on crowded public transport
causes.text: As Hong Kong's MTR carriages and buses grow ever more crowded, even a small personal device can intrude on dozens of strangers at once. The portable fan row reveals how shared, confined spaces amplify minor irritations into full-blown disputes, testing whether commuters can agree on unwritten rules of consideration when private comfort collides with communal space.

causes.label: Calls to legislate against handheld fan noise
causes.text: Frustrated commuters have urged lawmakers to set decibel limits on portable fans, much as noise ordinances already govern construction and nightlife. Critics counter that legislating against such a minor, everyday object risks trivialising the Legislative Council's time and raises thorny questions about how authorities would even enforce such a rule on a moving bus.

causes.label: Physiological need versus shared-space comfort
causes.text: Defenders of noisy fan users argue that the backlash overlooks genuine physical discomfort: outdoor labourers, the elderly and those prone to overheating may rely on a fan as a basic necessity rather than a luxury. This counter-view challenges the assumption that quietness should always trump a person's immediate bodily comfort in public.

causes.label: Judging strangers by the sound of their habits
causes.text: Underlying the dispute is an unspoken judgment about who gets to feel entitled to comfort in public: critics note that fan users are often assumed to be inconsiderate without regard for their circumstances, exposing how quickly online strangers leap to class-tinged assumptions about manners, upbringing and who truly belongs in a civilised public space.
